board: Adafruit ANO Rotary Navigation Encoder to I2C Stemma QT Adapter (product 5740, ATtiny816 seesaw, with ANO encoder 5001 fitted)
reason: The check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. The part is modelled as seesaw over I2C at 0x49: ENCODER 0x11/0x30 returns the signed 32-bit position, and GPIO_BULK 0x01/0x04 holds buttons SELECT/UP/LEFT/DOWN/RIGHT on seesaw pins 1-5 (active low). HW_ID reads 0x86 and VERSION reads product 5740. The header order VIN, GND, SCL, SDA, INT, UPDI comes from Adafruit's EAGLE board file.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-ANO-Rotary-Navigation-Encoder-to-I2C (JP1 pads 1-6 nets VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, INT, UPDI) and https://learn.adafruit.com/adafruit-ano-rotary-navigation-encoder-to-i2c-stemma-qt-adapter/pinouts
